message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Seeking Advice on Best VRAM Backend & Config for Multi-GPU AMD LLM Inference (Gemma3:27b, Qwen3 32B)","body":"I'm working with a multi-GPU AMD setup (2x Radeon RX 7900 XTX + 1x RX 7800 XT, totaling 64GB VRAM) and want to optimize inference for Gemma3:27b and Qwen3 32B models. I've seen some older tests showing only minor speed differences between VLLM and llama.cpp backends, but those were on smaller or older models. Vulkan with llama.cpp seemed faster for some large Qwen3 variants in one report, but details were limited. I'm curious about what quantization methods (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) and bit depths others have found effective on similar AMD multi-GPU rigs. Also, how do you best distribute workloads across these GPUs? Any recommended inference frameworks or specific config tweaks to maximize throughput and speed?
